evidence.source_rows: experiments/ptr-engine/measure/rows-longrun-c-2026-10-26.jsonl arm pointer-stable (48 turns, read-only, copy-only transform)

graders.grade_v2: exit 0 always (no binary verdict); new_accuracy pos-full 10/10, neg-one 7/10, neg-marker 10/10, neg-truncated 10/10, pos-exact-only 3/10
graders.schema_note: no grader reads answer_marker (grep 0 hits in both files); no scorecard field named false_claims (reported 0 from constraint_violations)
graders.usage: score_longrun.py FIXTURE RUN  |  grade_v2.py --rows RUN --fixture FIXTURE --out /tmp/qpc/*.json

pos_full_failure.found: the real turn-12 prose followed by 'The default per-turn resolve budget in refs is 64. ... ANSWER: 64' (full content compared, not the marker line)
pos_full_failure.code: score_longrun.py:814 defaults mode to 'exact' because checkpoints[] carry no match key; score_longrun.py:174-176 returns text == want over the whole turn content

evidence.why_no_log_can_pass_both: LR-01.v3.json answer_marker required:true demands an 'ANSWER: <value>' line, and 3 checkpoints + 4 mirror acceptance facts use exact whole-content match against bare values ('64','31',prose cp3); the only shape score_longrun accepts (bare '64') fails grade_v2 R1b (no concluding sentence), demonstrated by pos-exact-only 3/10 vs 10/10.

blocker: Checkpoint fact checks cp.t12/cp.t24/cp.t46 and mirrors acc.cp1/acc.cp2/acc.cp3/acc.1 compare the entire turn content to the expected value (exact mode by default, score_longrun.py:814 + :174-176), while the v3 fixture's required answer_marker demands an 'ANSWER:' line in that same content. No log can satisfy both, so verified_success can never be true on a real-shaped log.
assumptions: One arm (pointer-stable) and its 48 real rows are representative of the four arms; all four share the same fixture and the same exact-match path.

Synthetic logs keep every real row field verbatim except: fixture_sha256 set to the v3 fixture's on-disk digest (so fixture_file digest match is honest), and the content of turns 12/24/30/46/48 minimally extended to carry the expected values, the repair literal, and the turn-48 log facts.
tokens_to_verified_success is null on all false rows because the metric is only computed when verified is true (score_longrun.py:917-924); null means undefined, not zero.
The card's 'false_claims' has no scorecard counterpart; constraint_violations was 0 on every synthetic log and is reported as false_claims 0.
pos-exact-only is an extra diagnostic (bare literal checkpoint answers), not one of the four contracted logs; it exists to show which single shape the scorer does accept and that grade_v2 rejects it.

This sandbox gives each shell invocation a private /tmp, so the /tmp/qpc/*.jsonl logs are ephemeral; the full builder that regenerates all five logs and runs both graders in one call is embedded in QUALITY-POSITIVE-CONTROL.md (appendix), and the truth table is that call's output.
next_unit_hint: Do not spend live quality requests. Owner decision needed: either set match: "contains" on the checkpoint/mirror fact checks (marker line is a substring) or make run_longrun emit structured answers so exact match sees only the value. Then re-run this same positive-control set; expect pos-full true, neg-one/neg-marker/neg-truncated false for three distinct reasons. Separately, grade_v2 is too lenient on neg-marker and neg-truncated (10/10) and needs the marker/truncation checks before its accuracy numbers are quoted.
